author: Good Enough
description: Medieval medicine was far different from modern healthcare. If you became sick during the Middle Ages, one of the most common treatments was having your blood drained because doctors believed it could restore your body's balance. This Short explores why bloodletting became one of history's most widespread medical practices, and why it was used for centuries despite often doing more harm than good.
title: Medieval Medicine Was SCARY 🩸😧 #history #facts #medieval #shorts
